id.description: Payout ID, prefixed `wdrl_`, or the `cofr_` payout request ID returned by `POST /payouts` — both cancel the same payout.

account_id.description: Owning account ID, prefixed `biz_`. Provide exactly one of `account_id` or `user_id`.

user_id.description: Owning user ID, prefixed `user_`. Provide exactly one of `account_id` or `user_id`.

idempotency-key.description: A unique key that makes this request safe to retry. See [Idempotent requests](https://docs.whop.com/developer/api/idempotency).
